name: AI Pulse
author: Fernando Silva da Luz
description: AI model leader on the bar and the full AI Pulse leaderboard as a popup panel.

barWidget.description: Leader of the AI Pulse leaderboard; turns urgent when the server is down or curation is degraded. Left = leaderboard panel, right = settings, middle = refresh.

schema.label: Server port
schema.description: The AI Pulse background service port (Settings → Startup & service).

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Rankings only change when a poll lands; a minute is plenty. Opening the panel refreshes immediately.

schema.label: Rows in the panel
schema.description: How many models the leaderboard panel lists (your own picks always show).

schema.label: Show leader name on the bar
schema.description: Turn off for an icon-only reading that just tracks health.

schema.label: Max name length on the bar
schema.description: Longer model names are ellipsized on the bar; the panel has the full name.
